summary: Round 3 fixed red-first; VM gate green, assigned corpus categories clean, and unrelated failure identities unchanged.
body:
Accepted the Round 3 finding; rejected none. All earlier fixes remain intact.

Files changed this round:

- [export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs:214): embedding now checks the exact serialized endpoints against renderer frame times.
- [export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs:1052): one-frame regression and 786-interval NTSC sweep.

The earlier changes to `sr_core_corpus.rs` remain unchanged. No importer changes, dependencies, or borrowed code.

Cause and fix: exact Tick alignment does not ensure safe floating-point visibility. Both endpoints must now satisfy `previous_frame_time < serialized_endpoint <= current_frame_time`, in addition to exact frame alignment. Unsafe pairs retain one audioMix placement, picture `hasAudio="false"`, and a linkage-loss warning. This preserves the independent timing documented by [audioTrackType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixexport/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:6266). No new specification ambiguity arose; the fallback addresses renderer behavior.

Renderer issue for the coordinator: [sr-deliver/audio.rs:422](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-deliver/src/audio.rs:422) evaluates `k / fps`; [sr-eval/eval.rs:1055](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/eval.rs:1055) applies strict half-open visibility. At 24000/1001 fps, frame 9 evaluates to `0.37537499999999996`, below serialized start `0.375375`. For frames [9,10), neither frame contributes a clock, and [sr-audio/mix.rs:476](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-audio/src/mix.rs:476) produces silence instead of one frame of audio. Longer intervals lose their first frame; upward-rounded ends can add an extra frame. These sources were consulted, not copied.

The earlier renderer issue also remains: [mix.rs:479](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-audio/src/mix.rs:479) extrapolates the final mapped frame forward at 1×. Reversed source [5,6) should finish toward 5.0, but advances toward 5.083333 at 24 fps; 2× playback similarly slows for its last frame. Conservative fallback and `preservePitch="false"` remain.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn export(project: &Project, sequence: ItemId, format: Format, opts: &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>
pub(crate) fn export(p: &Project, seq_id: ItemId, opts: &ExportOptions, report: &mut Report) -> Result<String>
```

VM red→green log:

| Test | Observed red → green |
|---|---|
| `scene_export_review_fractional_boundary_one_frame_uses_mix` | 0 placements, expected 1 → passes, including exact audio timing after re-import |
| `scene_export_review_fractional_boundary_sweep` | 167 unsafe embedded intervals → none across 786 intervals at three NTSC rates |

Earlier audio deduplication, budget, transition, duplicate-ID, animation, subframe, reverse, and varispeed regressions still pass. All **53 export tests** pass.

Final VM gate: formatting and clippy `-D warnings` passed; **331 tests passed, 0 failed, 6 unrelated ignores**; wasm passed for **51 crates**.

Pinned corpus: **1,343 cases, 1,676 exports/schema checks, 3,352 successful re-imports**. Failure identities are unchanged:

| Category | Round 2 → Round 3 |
|---|---:|
| linked-audio | 0 → 0 |
| 10000-siblings | 0 → 0 |
| fractional-depth | 11 → 11 |
| external-expression | 122 → 122 |
| material-override | 6 → 6 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 → 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 → 14 |
| generated-id | 12 → 12 |

The corpus command exits 101 solely for those 183 unchanged unrelated failures. [Verification and adjacent raw logs](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/fixexport/round3-verification.json) record the evidence.

Task completed; locks released. Changes remain uncommitted.
